payload.reason: The evidence indicates that NCEL is effective, outperforming various baselines and achieving better performance metrics in multiple datasets.

claims.text: NCEL achieves the best performance with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1 compared to other methods.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines, demonstrating favorable generalization ability across different datasets.
In both easy and hard cases, NCEL outperforms all baseline methods, indicating its effectiveness in diverse scenarios.
The global module in NCEL significantly improves performance in hard cases compared to local methods, showcasing its effectiveness in challenging situations.
